name: robots/etaoxing__kitchen-shift
title: KitchenShift kitchen-v0 (MuJoCo Franka kitchen)
intro: KitchenShift kitchen-v0 (MuJoCo Franka kitchen), adapted from etaoxing/kitchen-shift. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
